title: 3 cyclic cube fields with two shortened coordinates

claims.statement: The explicit 3-field degree-334 cyclic cube encoder with shortened anchor, punctured parity and radius-68 depth-dependent local list decoder for 1000 message bits on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses have average block error at most 27591527597795877/500000000000000000.
